name: Sofia
personality: Gentle, zealous about Solel, with a huge appetite that eats her wages.
story: She grew up at Lyoshan Fort among bandits led by her father until he died in a dispute. By 1449 she is a priest at Solel's Temple in Dagsion. She joins automatically on Theodora's route as her first healer; other routes need high Renown and Support 3.

personalSkill.name: Healing Knowledge
personalSkill.effect: +10 HP when healing an ally with magic. Lv20: Distant Healing (Rng+1); Lv35: Distant Healing+ (Rng+2).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics S (elite healing support); KeenGamer B.

why: Ch 5 recruitment tutorial: the requirement is low and the game suggests her
recruit.tip: Recruit her the week the tutorial opens: every map she misses is heal EXP lost.

build.notes: Linear on purpose: Priest is her wait for Lv 35 and already doubles heals and trains White Magic +2 a fight. Her Arena seats go to Authority B (Healing Order?), not White Magic. Physic sits at her White Magic B (two sources).

guide.summary: The army's main healer. Stand two rows behind Theodora's choke and Physic from range; from Authority B keep the other healers within 3 so their heals get +10. End every turn out of bow range.
guide.playstyle: Heal first, attack second. Healing Knowledge, the [[item:Healing Staff]] and Bishop's Magic Heal stack to +30 on every heal, so Physic heals 38 from the back. Nosferatu only on foes that can't double her.
keys: Recruit her in the Ch 5 tutorial and deploy her every map from then.
Put the Enno Isle [[item:Healing Staff]] (Ch 7) on her and never take it off.
Train Authority to B in any free Heavy, Mage or Mounted seat: Healing Order.
Take [[class:Bishop]] at Lv 35 (Ch 10 or 11): Magic Heal +10 and Barrier.
Keep Theodora, Bonaventure and Sirocco within 3 when they heal: Healing Order +10?
End every turn out of bow range: Def grows 15 in Priest and Bishop.
watch: Def: 15 growth in Priest and Bishop. Two archer hits can finish her.
Weight: Healing Staff 3 to Part II; Part III adds Bronze Gauntlets +4 (Wt 2) = 5.
Range: Physic 1-10 (one source?); Distant Healing+ takes Heal and Recover to range 3.
Inventory: 2/6 to Part II, 3/6 in Part III (Bronze Gauntlets +4, Healing Staff, Concoction).

stages.goal: Second healer from her first map; train White Magic C for Priest. Healing Knowledge (+10 HP) is always on.
stages.exit: Lv 20 with White Magic C: Priest exam (Ch 6).

guide.alt: Troubadour only if you need her Mov: it halves her heal casts and drops Magic Heal to +5. Guardian needs Spear B she never trains.

routeNotes.note: Tobias in this army (Seteth as a filler). Meal seat: Theodora + Tobias + Sofia. She likes every recorded dish, so she never breaks a Perfect meal.

Fourth carrier: [[battalion:Priest Trainees]] from Ch 6, [[battalion:Holy Disciples]] (Res +2, Lck +2) at Authority C. Physic comes first; set a Recovery gambit only when her spot behind the line fits it.

Authority B gives Healing Order?: Healing Knowledge (+10 HP) spreads to every healer within 3. Lend Magic (C) and Lend Magic+ (A) boost the casters. How Authority arts fire in battle is not documented.

decisions.pick: Priest from Ch 6, Bishop at Lv 35 (Ch 10 or 11)
decisions.why: Priest already doubles her heals and trains White Magic +2 a fight, so no detour beats it. Bishop adds Magic Heal +10 and Barrier. Troubadour would halve her casts.

decisions.pick: Authority B by Ch 11; White Magic from battle
decisions.why: She heals every turn, so White Magic B comes from battle. Authority B gives Healing Order?: +10 HP on every nearby healer's heals, and the White-Magic Manuals go to Theodora instead.
